text: Every note went into a set or the plan, never the render: the line flows round 0451 nodding; the fingers close on a wrap circle (chords of radius 52 mm round the grip); the visor-bench strip became glass with an LED line under the bloom threshold; the outro silhouettes the dark army against an emergency-red shutter glow; s01 became one 15 s take (`oneTake` in the plan).
